full_details: You stayed inside Henley Street, stiff from yesterday's binding. In the morning you helped sort the stall bundles for Thursday and gather windfall apples. When a rush-gatherer came to the wicket you put your hand to your belt, and your father stayed your arm and told Anne to settle it from her own bag. No one named the coin. Before dinner you sat with Susanna and cast tallies on a slate, dozens into shillings, and nothing was bought. In the afternoon Judith and Hamnet and Edmund staged a pageant by the rain-barrel. Judith had been the horse and would not be the woman. You laughed until your ribs ached. The play bundle stayed tied.
one_sentence: You stayed in the house, your father let Anne settle the door, and the children made you laugh in the yard.
title: Anne's bag, and the pageant by the rain-barrel
